run_vs_env_script: run vs_env.py with a target architecture and command to execute in the Visual Studio environment
review_vs_toolchain_setup: review how vs_toolchain.SetEnvironmentAndGetRuntimeDllDirs configures the Visual Studio environment and runtime DLL directories
review_msvs_version_selection: review how gyp.MSVSVersion.SelectVisualStudioVersion selects the appropriate Visual Studio version for the build
refactor_subprocess_call: refactor the subprocess.call invocation to avoid shell=True for improved security when running commands
test_vs_env_cli: test the vs_env.py CLI script by passing a target architecture and a sample command to verify environment setup
